title: Function-preserving watermarking of AI-generated proteins
title_zh: AI生成蛋白的功能保留式水印技术
abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (AI) models are revolutionizing biology, with tools such as AlphaFold 3 and protein design models accelerating breakthroughs in protein structure prediction and the creation of new functional proteins 1 . Tracking and establishing the provenance of AI-generated protein sequences and structures is becoming increasingly important to tackle a range of emerging challenges, including biosecurity and concerns about information veracity 2–4 . Here we introduce SynthIDBio, a family of methods for watermarking protein sequences and structures to establish the provenance of those generated with AI. SynthIDBio-sequence actively embeds a watermark into protein sequences while preserving function. We demonstrate this by creating watermarked, functional designed protein binders with binding affinity comparable with non-watermarked counterparts and near-perfect watermark detection accuracy. Furthermore, SynthIDBio-structure, a fine-tuned AlphaFold3 model, embeds an imperceptible watermark into biomolecular structures. Our work is a proof-of-concept that function-preserving biological watermarking is feasible, introducing a potential tool for provenance in the rapidly expanding era of AI-driven biological engineering.
abstract_zh: 摘要：生成式人工智能（AI）模型正在革新生物学，AlphaFold 3等工具以及蛋白质设计模型正在加速蛋白结构预测和新功能蛋白的创建1。跟踪并确立AI生成蛋白序列和结构的来源正变得日益重要，以应对包括生物安全和信息真实性等一系列新兴挑战2–4。本文提出 SynthIDBio，一系列用于给AI生成的蛋白序列和结构打水印以确立其来源的方法。SynthIDBio‑sequence 在保持蛋白功能的同时主动将水印嵌入蛋白序列。我们通过创建带水印的功能性设计蛋白结合体来证明其可行性，这些结合体的结合亲和力与无水印对应物相当，并且水印检测准确率几乎完美。进一步地，SynthIDBio‑structure 是一个微调的 AlphaFold3 模型，能够在生物分子结构中嵌入不可察觉的水印。我们的工作证明了功能保留的生物水印是可行的，并为快速扩张的 AI 驱动生物工程时代提供了一种潜在的来源追溯工具。
